name: federal-grants
title: Federal grants accounting under the Uniform Guidance
summary: Grants accounting under 2 CFR Part 200 at its 2024 amounts: allowable and indirect costs, cost sharing, program income, equipment, procurement, award dates and the single audit.
description: Each task states the facts of an unnamed recipient's Federal award: a budget, purchases, spending and dates. The AI reads the Office of Management and Budget's rules for Federal awards, 2 CFR Part 200, and gives exact answers: modified total direct costs, which costs are allowable, what counts as cost sharing, a procurement method, whether an audit is required, or a due date. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Allowable costs
families.what: Which charges the cost principles allow, where the text gives a clear rule or the answer turns on a fact the question states.

families.name: Indirect costs
families.what: Modified total direct costs with every exclusion the definition lists, and indirect costs at the de minimis rate.

families.name: Cost sharing
families.what: How much of the cash, in-kind contributions and unrecovered indirect costs on offer counts toward a cost sharing requirement.

families.name: Program income
families.what: What counts as program income, which method applies, and the arithmetic of the deduction, addition and cost sharing methods.

families.name: Equipment and supplies
families.what: Equipment or supplies by the capitalization threshold, the acquisition cost, and what is owed when the recipient disposes of them.

families.name: Procurement
families.what: The procurement method by amount, self-certified thresholds, bonding minimums and awards made without competition.

families.name: Award dates
families.what: Closeout, financial reports, record retention, pre-award costs and a one-time extension, as dates.

families.name: Audit requirement
families.what: Whether an audit is required, what counts as Federal awards expended, and the oversight agency for audit.

families.name: Audit deadlines
families.what: The due date of the reporting package, moved off weekends and holidays where the rule says so, and the dates for the management decision and the auditor's records.

families.name: Major programs
families.what: The Type A threshold, Type A and Type B programs, large loan programs, coverage and questioned costs.
